map.由摆长求单摆周期 使用指南: Deriving the Simple Pendulum Period from the Length User Guide
map.单摆周期计算器，输入摆长 L 与重力加速度 g 按 T=2π√(L/g) 求周期: The simple pendulum period calculator takes the pendulum length L and gravitational acceleration g and computes the period from T = 2*pi*sqrt(L/g), for vibration and timing analysis.
map.T = 2π√(L/g)（小角度）。 L=1m,g=9.81 → 约 2.01: T = 2*pi*sqrt(L/g) (small angle). L=1m, g=9.81 -> about 2.01 s.
map.输入摆长 L 与重力加速度 g，求周期。: Enter the pendulum length L and the gravitational acceleration g to get the period.
map.单摆计时：录入摆长求周期，理解摆钟调长对走时的影响。: Simple pendulum timing: enter the length to get the period and understand how lengthening a pendulum slows the clock.
map.周期比较：对不同摆长求 T，演示 T∝√L（与质量、振幅小角度无关）。: Period comparison: solve for T at different lengths to show that T scales as sqrt(L) (independent of mass and, at small angles, amplitude).
map.教学演示：演示摆长加倍周期约变 1.41 倍。: Teaching demo: shows that doubling the length multiplies the period by about 1.41.
map.：示例：L=1 m、g=9.8，T=2π√(1/9.8)≈2.01 s。: Example: L=1 m and g=9.8 gives T = 2*pi*sqrt(1/9.8) = about 2.01 s.

map.小角度下单摆周期与质量无关，只取决于摆长与 g。结果按标准力学公式实时计算，供物: At small angles the simple pendulum period is independent of the bob mass and depends only on the length and g. Results are computed in real time from the standard mechanics formula for physics study, homework calculations and engineering estimates; for safety-critical or real engineering work follow professional standards and measured data.
map.大角度还准吗？: Is it still accurate at large angles?
map.大角度（如 >15°）周期略长于小角度公式值，需用椭圆积分修正。结果按标准力学公: At large angles (say above 15 degrees) the period is slightly longer than the small-angle formula value and needs an elliptic integral correction. Results are computed in real time from the standard mechanics formula for physics study, homework calculations and engineering estimates; for safety-critical or real engineering work follow professional standards and measured data.
map.g 不同会怎样？: What happens with a different g?
map.T∝1/√g；月球上 g 小，同摆长周期更长，钟会变慢。结果按标准力学公式实时计: T scales as 1/sqrt(g); on the Moon g is small so the same pendulum has a longer period and the clock runs slow. Results are computed in real time from the standard mechanics formula for physics study, homework calculations and engineering estimates; for safety-critical or real engineering work follow professional standards and measured data.
map.→ 打开由摆长求单摆周期工具: -> Open the tool that derives the simple pendulum period from the pendulum length
map.小角度近似下 T = 2π√(L/g)，输入摆长 L（m）与重力加速度 g（默认: Under the small-angle approximation, T = 2π√(L/g). Enter the pendulum length L (m) and gravitational acceleration g (default 9.81 m/s²) to get the period T (s).
map.输入摆长 L（悬点到摆球中心的距离，单位 m）。: Enter the pendulum length L (distance from the pivot to the bob center, in meters).
map.重力加速度 g 默认 9.81，月球等场景可改。: Gravitational acceleration g defaults to 9.81; change it for scenarios such as the Moon.
map.结果区显示周期 T，保留 3 位小数。: The result panel shows the period T to three decimal places.
map.物理实验测重力加速度（反解 g = 4π²L/T²）。: Measuring gravitational acceleration in physics experiments (solving backward for g = 4π²L/T²).
map.摆球质量影响周期吗？: Does the bob mass affect the period?
map.不影响。理想单摆周期与质量无关。: No. The period of an ideal simple pendulum is independent of mass.
map.大角度为什么不准？: Why is it inaccurate at large angles?
map.大角度时回复力不再是线性近似，周期会略长于公式值。: At large angles the restoring force is no longer linear, so the period is slightly longer than the formula predicts.
